mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_grants (id, activity_id, user_id, lease_id, member_generation, policy_revision, kind, token_hash, public_key, allowed_paths, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{activityId}, #{userId}, #{leaseId}, #{memberGeneration}, #{policyRevision}, #{kind}, #{tokenHash}, #{publicKey}, #{allowedPaths}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_grants SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE id = #{grantId}
UPDATE activity_grants SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE activity_grants SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE lease_id = #{leaseId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connection_leases lease WHERE lease.id != #{leaseId} AND lease.revoked_at IS NULL AND lease.expires_at > statement_timestamp() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_grants ticket WHERE ticket.lease_id = lease.id AND ticket.activity_id = lease.activity_id AND ticket.user_id = lease.user_id AND ticket.kind = 'VOICE' AND ticket.revoked_at IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lease_id) FROM activity_grants WHERE kind = 'NETWORK' AND lease_id != #{leaseId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > statement_timestamp()
